visual_goal: Show the advert composed from facts, price, media and checked text, then passing disclosure rules and the quality scorer before it is stored and published.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration. On the left, stacked vertically, three source boxes: a folder icon labeled 'Dossier facts', a plain price-tag icon with a euro sign (€), labeled 'Price', and a camera icon labeled 'Media pipeline'. Below them a magnifier-over-text box labeled 'Claim checker'. In the center-left a large assembly box labeled 'Advert composer'. One arrow from each of 'Dossier facts', 'Price' and 'Media pipeline' into 'Advert composer'. One double-headed arrow between 'Claim checker' and 'Advert composer', labeled 'checked text'. Then a strictly linear chain to the right: one arrow from 'Advert composer' to a rulebook box labeled 'Disclosure rules', one arrow from 'Disclosure rules' to a gauge box labeled 'Quality scorer', one arrow from 'Quality scorer' to a database cylinder labeled 'Revision store', and one arrow from 'Revision store' to a broadcast box labeled 'Syndication'.
alt: Dossier facts, price and the media pipeline feed the advert composer, which exchanges text with the claim checker; drafts pass disclosure rules and the quality scorer into the revision store, from which syndication publishes.

visual_goal: Show photos moving from guided phone capture through ingest, processing and classification into one ordered master set, from which channels get renditions.
prompt: A left-to-right pipeline illustration. Far left: a smartphone showing a car outline overlay, labeled 'Guided capture'. One arrow labeled 'resumable upload' into a funnel box labeled 'Ingest'. One arrow from 'Ingest' into a box with crop marks labeled 'Process'. One arrow from 'Process' into a box with angle markers around a small generic car labeled 'Classify'. One arrow from 'Classify' into a neat stack of photo cards labeled 'Ordered media set'. From 'Ordered media set' exactly three arrows fan out to the right: one up to a vault cylinder labeled 'Master store', one straight right labeled 'renditions' to a broadcast box labeled 'Syndication', and one down to a browser window labeled 'Dealer website'.
alt: Guided capture on a phone uploads to ingest, processing and classification, producing an ordered media set that goes to the master store, syndication as renditions, and the dealer website.

visual_goal: Show generation grounded in one fact-sheet version, an unsupported claim caught and regenerated, and the dealer's edit checked by the same claim checker.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration with four vertical lanes, each headed by an icon and a label: a plain open box with no letters on it labeled 'Composer', a pen-and-gear box labeled 'Generator', a magnifier box labeled 'Claim checker', and a generic person at a laptop labeled 'Dealer'. Horizontal arrows between lanes, top to bottom: an arrow from 'Composer' to 'Generator' labeled 'fact sheet'; an arrow from 'Generator' to 'Claim checker' labeled 'draft'; a return arrow from 'Claim checker' to 'Generator' in orange labeled 'one unsupported'; an arrow from 'Generator' to 'Claim checker' labeled 'revised draft'; a return arrow from 'Claim checker' to 'Generator' in green labeled 'all supported'; an arrow from 'Generator' to 'Composer' labeled 'checked text'; an arrow from 'Composer' to 'Dealer' labeled 'draft ready'; a final short arrow from the 'Dealer' lane leftward whose arrowhead stops on the 'Claim checker' lane line, labeled 'dealer edit'. No letters inside any icon.
alt: Swimlanes for composer, generator, claim checker and dealer: the fact sheet becomes a draft, one unsupported claim is caught, the revised draft passes, and the dealer's edit goes through the same checker.
